Find the entities in this text: The injury-plagued Indianapolis Colts lost another quarterback on Thursday but last year's AFC finalists rallied together to shoot down the Philadelphia Eagles 37-10 in a showdown of playoff contenders. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Indianapolis closes with games at Kansas City and Cincinnati. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The Eagles were held without a touchdown until the final five seconds. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Philadelphia, which fell from an NFC East tie with the Dallas Cowboys and Washington Redskins, go on the road against the New York Jets and then entertain Arizona. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Faulk carried 16 times, including a 13-yard TD run in the first quarter and a seven-yard score early in the final period. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Justin made his second straight start for Harbaugh, who has a knee injury. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Justin suffered a sprained right shoulder in the third quarter and did not return. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Chile and Mexico will start negotiations next year to broaden their free trade agreement to include services and investments, Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Chile hopes to broaden the treaty signed in 1994 beyond reduction of tariffs on imports and exports and add provisions covering services and investment codes, said Aninat. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: East Timorese Roman Catholic Bishop Carlos Belo left Dili on Friday on his way to Norway for the awards ceremony as co-recipient of the 1996 Nobel Peace Prize. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Witnesses said Belo left the territory for the Indonesian capital Jakarta accompanied by five other people. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: It was not immediately known when he would arrive in Oslo. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The bishop will jointly receive the Nobel award next Tuesday with East Timorese-born activist Jose Ramos Horta, who lives in self-exile in Australia. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The Indonesian government has condemned the inclusion of Ramos Horta in the award, and Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said on Friday that Indonesia would not be represented officially at the ceremony in the Norwegian capital. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "I sincerely believe that this unfortunate choice in giving the honour to such a controversial figure as Ramos Horta ... Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: will exacerbate the problem in finding a solution (to East Timor), "Alatas said on Friday. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: He was responding to questions at a news conference called to discuss next week's ministerial meeting of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) in Jakarta. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Ramos Horta has been a vocal leader of the opposition to Jakarta's rule in the territory. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Belo and Ramos Horta were awared the prize for their efforts to secure a peaceful solution to the issue of East Timor, a former Portuguese colony which Indonesia invaded in 1975 and annexed the following year. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The United Nations has never recognised Jakarta's move. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Alatas said the government's position on the Nobel Peace Prize would have been different if it had been awarded solely to Belo. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Asked if the Indonesian ambassador to Norway would have attended the ceremony if only Belo had been involved, Alatas replied: "Probably, yes, but that is a hypothetical question." Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Alatas said on Tuesday that on his way back from Oslo, Belo would visit the Vatican to see the Pope, and would also meet German Chancellor Helmut Kohl in Bonn. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Kohl had wanted to meet Belo during the chancellor's official visit to Indonesia last month, but the bishop was too busy in East Timor to come to Jakarta. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Burmese troops and riot police moved in to disperse a student street protest at a suburban road junction near the Ranyon (Rangoon) University early on Saturday, witnesses said. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: They said police and troops used water cannons from fire engines to subdue about 120 university students sitting in at the centre of the junction at about 3 a.m. before they moved in to round them up. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The students, who had staged an 11-hour protest at the junction in northern Rangoon, were taken away in three vehicles. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The witnesses said some of the students were hit with batons while they were herded onto the vehicles and it was believed they were taken to the Insein prison in suburban Rangoon. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The protesting students, mostly from Rangoon University, were demanding the right to organise independent unions on campuses and the release of about 80 student leaders currently in jail. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: They were among 500 students who started demonstrating at the intersection on late Friday afternoon. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The protest was the second major one in five days in the capital. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Burmese students march briefly out of campus. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: About 200 Burmese students marched briefly from troubled Yangon Institute of Technology in northern Rangoon on Friday towards the University of Yangon six km (four miles) away, and returned to their campus, witnesses said. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Seven truckloads of armed riot police and three fire engines were on standby at one of the junctions near the institute. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: There were no clashes. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "They are now back in the YIT campus," an institute official who declined to be identified told Reuters by telephone. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: One of two roads leading to the University of Yangon from the institute had been closed by authorities. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: But about 300 university students were still gathered outside the gates of their campus, witnesses said. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: They were singing peacefully. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: On Monday and Tuesday, students from the institute and the university launched protests against what they said was unfair handling by police of a brawl between some of their colleagues and restaurant owners in October. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: On Tuesday and Wednesday, opposition leader Aung San Suu Kyi was restricted to her home by the military government to prevent her from being drawn into the protests. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: She was allowed to move freely on Thursday. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The protest culminated at dawn on Tuesday with several hundred students being detained briefly by police in central Rangoon. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The street protests were the biggest seen in the capital since the student-led pro-democracry demonstrations of September 1988 when the junta crushed the uprising. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Thousands were killed or imprisoned. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Earlier on Friday some of the students, who were held briefly by police during the protests earlier this week, said they were still dissatisfied with the military government. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: They told Reuters they were unhappy that the ruling State Law and Order Restoration Council (SLORC) had not heeded their calls for the right to organise independent unions on campus. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "We still want government answers to our demands. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: We want police punishment to be published in newspapers, "one student said. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: But the students stressed their protests were non-political and they had no contact with Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD). Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Suu Kyi, a Nobel laureate and daughter of independence hero Aung San, and key NLD officials have also denied any link with the students. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: But they have said both parties had a "moral link" in that they were against police brutality and injustice. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The students also demanded the government announce punishments meted out to policemen who they said had manhandled students involved in a brawl with some restaurant owners near the Yangon institute in October. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The students appealed to the government not to close the institute because of their latest demonstration. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: The institute was shut for nearly two years after the 1988 uprising. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: On Friday, the road leading to Suu Kyi's lakeside residence in central Rangoon remained closed by police. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Bill Jordan, general secretary of the International Confederation of Free Trade Unions (ICFTU), told a news conference the withdrawal of a WTO invitation to ILO director general Michel Hansenne was "outrageous behaviour on the part of an organisation that wants to command respect in the world". Find the entities in this text: For synthetic rubber, production reached 68,200 tonnes in 1995/96 while consumption in the same season hit 134,085 tonnes, Matthew added. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: "Though schemes designed to realise further increases in the production of natural rubber are being operated successfully, the demand-supply gap is expected to widen," he said. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Indian synthetic rubber output is not expected to rise significantly in the next season but demand will rise to 145,000 tonnes. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: One way to bridge the widening gap is to put more land under cultivation which the Rubber Board official estimates will reach 220,000 hectares between now and the year 2003 although Matthew said this may not be possible at this time in India. Find the entities in this text: Comments by Japan's tight-lipped central bank chief and an influential top bureaucrat are further signs that the nation's authorities want to keep the dollar at current levels, market sources said on Friday. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: In a rare expression of a view on currencies by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor, Yasuo Matsushita was quoted in Japan's leading economic daily on Friday as saying that he sees no further, immediate fall in the yen. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: This followed a widely watched television appearance late on Thursday by Eisuke Sakakibara, a high-ranking Finance Ministry official, who denied he had said he wants to guide the dollar lower to between 108 and 110 yen. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: But many in the market thought Sakakibara's real intentions lay elsewhere, and took more notice of his comments about the U.S. government's stance on the dollar, dealers said. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: "I think his views on (U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert) Rubin's comments were indeed what he himself thinks about the dollar," said Hank Note, chief dealer at Sumitomo Bank. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Asked about Rubin's comment that a strong dollar was in U.S. interests, Sakakibara said the remark does not necessarily mean the United States supports a stronger dollar. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "It's a strong dollar, not stronger. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: In that sense, the comments are not pointing to a certain direction, "he said. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "It shows that Sakakibara is not for a stronger dollar either," said Sumitomo's Note. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Takao Sakoh, first vice president at Union Bank of Switzerland in Tokyo, said: "Maybe a dollar at 104.50 yen is not acceptable (to Sakakibara), but it may be okay at the current level, at the lower end of 112 yen." Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Market participants have kept a close eye on Sakakibara, chief of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, as a comment he made in November after the dollar hit this year's high of 114.92 yen pushed the currency down sharply. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: He had said then that the market's view on Japan's economy was too pessimistic and that he believed it was stronger than the market thought. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Dealers have come to refer to 115 yen as the "Sakakibara ceiling" for the dollar following the remark. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Adding to the comments by "Mr Yen", as Sakakibara is known for his prominence in the currency market, was BOJ governor Matsushita's remark. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: "The recent level of the yen exchange rate has been stable, and it does not appear to be moving towards a further depreciation of the yen immediately, so import prices are likely to stabilise at current levels," Matsushita said in an interview with the Nihon Keizai Shimbun. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: "The fact that he touched on the issue of inflation triggered by import prices shows that the BOJ does not want a further depreciation of the yen, past 115 yen," said Yasuhito Kawashima, chief forex manager at Toyo Trust & Banking Co. Find the entities in this text: A Lebanese military court on Friday sentenced to death in absentia the commander of Israel's surrogate militia in south Lebanon on treason charges. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The court convicted General Antoine Lahd, head of the South Lebanon Army (SLA), of collaborating with Israel with which Lebanon is officially at war. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Lahd, a 69-year-old former Lebanese army major-general, heads the 3,000-strong SLA militia which helps Israel hold a border zone in south Lebanon to ward off cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Lahd said a few days after the trial began on February 16 that Lebanese authorities must drop the charges or risk blocking any peace deal with the Jewish state. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: He said Israel was capable of pressuring Lebanon's Syrian-backed government to stop the legal pursuit. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The charges against Lahd were: forming a hostile army, carrying weapons on Israel's side, helping Israel strip off a part of Lebanese territory by violence, forming an armed gang, killing or trying to kill Lebanese civilians by artillery shelling and kidnapping Lebanese citizens for long periods. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Shortly before Lahd's trial began, a Beirut military prosecutor charged another 89 former Lebanese army soldiers with collaborating with Israel. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: No date has been set for the trial of the men, all members of the SLA living in the Israeli-held zone in south Lebanon. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Israel and Lahd have repeatedly demanded safety guarantees for the SLA -- a mixed Christian-Shi'ite Moslem force -- which the Jewish states regards as loyal allies. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Israel has said the Lebanese army must incorporate the SLA fighters into its ranks as an army brigade as a condition for peace. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: But Lebanese political analysts have said that would be out of the question and Lebanese authorities pre-empted the issue by taking legal action against Lahd. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Former Israeli Prime Minister Shimon Peres, calling Lahd "a great Lebanese patriot", said earlier this year Lebanon had insulted the SLA commander by ordering his arrest on the treason charges. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Peres, who was ousted in May by rightwing Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu, said there could not be real negotiations with Lebanon "unless it will stop the maltreatment of the SLA and its commanders." Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The Beirut military court also sentenced to life in jail in absentia Etian Saqr, former head of the pro-Israeli Guardians of the Cedars, a small rightwing Christian civil war militia. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Saqr, whose trial was concurrent with Lahd's, was convicted of "contacting the Israeli enemy, passing information to Israel and undertaking hostile acts against Lebanon". Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: BOBSLEIGH-SHIMER PILOTS USA III TO SURPRISE WIN. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: IGLS, Austria 1996-12-07 Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Brian Shimer piloted USA III to a surprise victory in a World Cup two-man bobsleigh race on Saturday. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Lying fifth after the first run, Shimer and breakman Randy Jones delivered a near-perfect second trip down the 1976 Olympic course for an aggregate time of one minute 45.91 seconds. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: First run leaders Guenther Huber and breakman Antonio Tartaglia in the Italy I sleigh finished second two-hundredths of a second behind the Americans. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Canada I, represented by Pierre Lueders and breakman Dave MacEachern, completed the third World cup event of the winter a further one-hundredth of a second behind the Italians. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: The Canadians, winners of the opening two events in Altenberg, Germany, and La Plagne, France, increased their lead in the World Cup standings. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: They have 104 points, 15 ahead of USA I's Jim Herberich and breakman Garrett Hines who managed only 10th place on Saturday. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: SKIING-CHINESE MAKE PROMISING FREESTYLE SKIING DEBUT. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: TIGNES, France 1996-12-07 Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: China made a promising debut on the freestyle skiing world cup circuit in an aerials event in the French resort of Tignes on Saturday. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: While the Chinese failed to gain a place in the men's final, they had two in the top 10 of the women's competition, Cuo Dan finishing a respectable seventh and Xu Nannan ninth. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: But overall, it was France and Canada who dominated the day. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Alexis Blanc and Sebastien Foucras gave France a one-two finish in the first aerials competition of the season. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Blanc collected his seventh career World Cup win with a two jump combined score of 238.36 points, easily beating Foucras, the overall World Cup aerials champion, who was a distant second with 223.60. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Canada's Jeff Bean, who had never finished higher than ninth in a World Cup event, made his first trip to the podium taking third place with a mark of 209.96. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Veronica Brenner of Canada, who picked up her first career victory at Tignes last year, made it two wins in a row at the French resort taking first in the women's competition with a score of 170.42. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Swiss skiers occupied the other two places on the podium, Karin Kuster taking second with 160.55 narrowly ahead of Evelyne Leu with 160.36. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: CRICKET - WOOLMER MAKES SENTIMENTAL RETURN TO KANPUR. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: KANPUR, India 1996-12-07 Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: South Africa's trip to Kanpur for the third test against India has given former England test cricketer Bob Woolmer the chance of a sentimental return to his birthplace. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: Woolmer was born in the northern city of Kanpur when his father worked there for an insurance compnay and was himself an active cricketer. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "It's been a sentimental journey ... Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: A visit to India is always an intriguing experience, "Woolmer, now the South African coach, said on Saturday. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Woolmer, 48, played 19 tests for England between 1975 and 1981. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: His first cricketing sojurn to India was as a member of Tony Greig's England side in 1976-77. Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: His father Clarence Woolmer represented United Province, now renamed Uttar Pradesh, in India's Ranji Trophy national championship and captained the state during 1949. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Now aged 86, Woolmer senior lives with his son in Cape Town. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Woolmer's memories of Kanpur are few and blurred. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "I don't remember much of the place," he said. " Use this order: first to last Entities:

Find the entities in this text: I came here on zero and left at three (aged three) when my father was transferred to Calcutta where I spent another four and half years. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: "But I do remember we had a cobra snake in the basement of our house. Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Also that my father bought a bicycle and when we rode over a hose pipe it broke into two. " Use this order: first to last Entities:
Find the entities in this text: Woolmer said the hospital where he was born is close to the stadium where the India-South Africa test will be played. Use this order: first to last Entities:
